perplexity_defense.notes: Ideal detector behavior: optimized=True, random=True, natural=False. On a randomly-initialized tiny model the perplexities are not calibrated, so the verdicts below are not meaningful. Whether a perplexity threshold separates optimized gibberish suffixes from natural text on real aligned models is an untested hypothesis (cf. 'smooth-LLM' style defenses, which specifically defeat it) - it must be measured, not assumed.
